$comment: COVER PLATES — original artwork made for this project.
These are the only film images this site will ever render, and they are ours:
abstract plates in the site's own palette, generated for this project. They
carry no text, no lettering, no logos, no faces and no character likeness, so
they cannot be mistaken for a studio's key art.
WHY NOT THE REAL POSTERS: a film's poster belongs to its studio or
distributor. Reproducing one on a venue's commercial site without a licence
is not a grey area, and no amount of searching produces a licence. So the
plate stands in, and every surface that shows one says plainly that it is
original cover art rather than the film's poster.
THE TWO WAYS A REAL POSTER GETS HERE LATER: the venue supplies a licensed
file, or the ticketing partner's feed delivers one with a stated licence on
an allow-listed host. Either replaces the plate for that film automatically —
`artwork` below is only consulted when the record has no artwork of its own.
EDITING RULES: add a slug here only after the matching file exists at
public/cover-art/<slug>.jpg. A slug with no file, or a file with no slug,
fails `npm run check`. Never add a poster URL, a studio image or a downloaded
licence: Original cover art made for this project
note: Original abstract cover art. Not the film's poster.
